setup: PRAGMA encoding='UTF-8'
CREATE TABLE t(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,base TEXT)
INSERT INTO t VALUES(1,'old')
ALTER TABLE t ADD COLUMN tx TEXT DEFAULT 'ténant'
ALTER TABLE t ADD COLUMN nu NUMERIC DEFAULT '12.0'
ALTER TABLE t ADD COLUMN re REAL DEFAULT 7
ALTER TABLE t ADD COLUMN bl BLOB DEFAULT x'00ff'
ALTER TABLE t ADD COLUMN ni INTEGER DEFAULT -9223372036854775808
ALTER TABLE t ADD COLUMN zz DEFAULT NULL
ALTER TABLE t ADD COLUMN nt TEXT DEFAULT 1.25
ALTER TABLE t ADD COLUMN bo DEFAULT TRUE
INSERT INTO t(id,base,tx,nu,re,bl,ni,zz,nt,bo) VALUES(2,'null',NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL)
INSERT INTO t(id,base) VALUES(3,'new')
CREATE INDEX ix ON t(tx,nu,re)

cases.sql: SELECT id,tx,nu,re,bl,ni,zz,nt,bo FROM t NOT INDEXED ORDER BY id
SELECT id,tx,nu,re FROM t INDEXED BY ix ORDER BY tx,id
SELECT x.id,y.tx,y.re,y.bl FROM t x LEFT JOIN t y ON y.id=x.id+1 ORDER BY x.id
SELECT x.id,y.tx,y.re FROM t x JOIN t y ON y.id=x.id ORDER BY x.id
SELECT id,typeof(tx),typeof(nu),typeof(re),typeof(bl),typeof(ni),typeof(zz),typeof(nt),typeof(bo) FROM t ORDER BY id
SELECT id,tx FROM t WHERE tx='ténant' ORDER BY id
SELECT count(tx),sum(nu),sum(re) FROM t
